name: 百度输入法
description: 合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
text:
#!name=百度输入法
#!desc=合并了 2 个原模块。原作者及版本见来源记录。
#!format=sgmodule

# 来源 ext-wool-0059 / 百度输入法 / 奶思
# 来源 ext-surge-0347 / 百度输入法去广告 / Keywos[https://github.com/Keywos]

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/r6\.mo\.baidu\.com\/res\/file\/advertisement\/files\/.+\.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/res\.mi\.baidu\.com\/imeres\/ime-res\/advertisement\/files\/.+\.jpg/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/activity\/advertisementnonrealtime/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/start_screen_ads\/list/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/hotpatch\/check\?hotpatch/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/start_screen_ads\/list/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/sapi\/v1\/lccorpus\/(applist|pannellist)/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/sapi\/v1\/circle\/joinedlist/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/commer\/pocket_api\/enterprise_list/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/mbd\.baidu\.com\/ccs\/v1\/start\/confsync\?appname=baidu_input/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
百度输入法去广告 = type=http-response, pattern=^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/(imrobot\/v1\/pub\/relation\/get_robot_list|v5\/custom_page\/(layout|getdata)), script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/Baidu_input_method/Baidu_input_method_remove_ads.js, requires-body=true

[Map Local]
^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/start_screen_ads/list data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/sapi\/v1\/lccorpus\/(applist|pannellist) data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/sapi\/v1\/(circle\/joinedlist|lccorpus\/usercorpussync|aihelpactivity\/aihelpresource) data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https?:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/commer\/pocket_api\/enterprise_list data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https?:\/\/mbd\.baidu\.com\/ccs\/v1\/start\/confsync\?appname=baidu_input data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"
^https:\/\/mime\.baidu\.com\/v5\/(fb\/st\?logtype|(notiv3|cellloc_noti|noti_cloudswitch_noti)\/info) data-type=text data="{}" status-code=200 header="Content-Type:application/json"

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% r6.mo.baidu.com, res.mi.baidu.com, mime.baidu.com, mbd.baidu.com, imeres.baidu.com
